passages:
WhatsApp chat with Hannah
Hannah, me
Thursday 4 September 2025, afternoon
Hannah: still no call about the biopsy results
Hannah: they said by thursday and it's thursday
me: it's only 2pm, they call late in the day
Hannah: i know. i keep checking my phone every 5 min
me: want me to come over tonight either way
Hannah: yes please. dont say anything smart just come

WhatsApp chat with Sven
Sven, me
Tuesday 16 April 2024, morning
Sven: der arzt hat mich für 4 wochen krankgeschrieben
me: krass. wie fühlst du dich damit
Sven: erleichtert und schuldig gleichzeitig. burnout steht auf dem zettel
me: du hast seit märz keinen urlaub genommen, das war absehbar
Sven: ich kann nicht mal ne mail öffnen ohne herzrasen
me: dann lass das handy aus, ich bring dir suppe

Discord chat with Marcus (username marcus_ln)
Marcus (username marcus_ln), me
Thursday 20 February 2025, night
Marcus: it's 4:12 and i'm awake again
me: same thing as last week?
Marcus: yeah i fall asleep fine then wake at 3 and my brain starts the to-do list
me: have you tried getting up instead of lying there
Marcus: i tried melatonin, just gave me weird dreams
Marcus: doctor appointment on monday, hope she has something better

WhatsApp chat with Aylin
Aylin, me
Monday 13 March 2023, evening
Aylin: morgen ist mein erstes gespräch bei der therapeutin
me: aufgeregt?
Aylin: ich hab schon dreimal überlegt abzusagen
me: tu's nicht, die ersten 10 minuten sind am schlimmsten
Aylin: und was wenn sie denkt ich stell mich an
me: dafür sind die da, du kannst nix falsch erzählen

Discord chat with Tess (username tess.vd)
Tess (username tess.vd), me
Wednesday 8 April 2026, evening
Tess: so the psychiatrist finally said it. adhd, combined type
me: how do you feel about that
Tess: weirdly like i'm not lazy
Tess: thirty-one years of thinking i was just bad at being a person
me: that's a lot to take in
Tess: she wants me to try methylphenidate, i start monday

WhatsApp group "Familie Brandt"

Sunday 6 November 2022, evening

me: ich schick euch das rezept von dem linsengericht

WhatsApp chat with Jule

Discord chat with Omar (username omar_k)
Omar (username omar_k), me
Tuesday 24 June 2025, evening
Omar: had a panic attack on the u-bahn today
me: shit. are you ok now
Omar: yeah. couldn't breathe, got out at the next stop and sat on the platform for like 20 min
Omar: a woman asked if i needed an ambulance, so embarrassing
me: not embarrassing, you handled it
Omar: first time in two years. i thought it was over

WhatsApp chat with Ben
Ben, me
Tuesday 18 March 2025, afternoon
Ben: it's a year today
me: i know. i was going to text you
Ben: i went to the cemetery this morning, mum had already put flowers there
Ben: i just stood there and was angry at him for dying before we could talk about the thing
me: which thing
Ben: any thing. the last time we spoke was about the car insurance

WhatsApp chat with Clara
Clara, me
Tuesday 14 February 2023, evening
me: you didn't come to yoga and you haven't answered since sunday
Clara: sorry. i'm fine
me: you don't have to be fine with me
Clara: it's just a lot of days lately where i don't see the point of getting dressed
me: ok. i'm bringing food over and i'm not going to ask you to talk
Clara: ...ok. thank you

Discord chat with Omar (username omar_k)

Tuesday 7 October 2025, morning

answered.q: Someone waits for biopsy results and cannot stop checking their phone.
Jule hat seit neun Tagen keine Zigarette geraucht.
Someone has a panic attack on the u-bahn and sits on the platform.
Wegen einer Migräne mit Flimmern und Übelkeit sagt jemand ab.
Der Vater hat die Diagnose Typ-2-Diabetes bekommen.
Someone has gone twelve days without alcohol.
Wegen völliger Erschöpfung bleibt jemand einen Monat von der Arbeit weg.
Someone keeps waking in the middle of the night with their mind racing and is going to see a doctor about it.
A blood test shows fat levels far too high and the doctor prescribes a change in what he eats.
After a cycling accident someone has to stay off screens for a week because of a head injury.
A constant high-pitched noise in the ear after a night of loud music sends someone to a specialist.
Eine Läuferin muss wegen eines Knochenschadens im Fuss acht Wochen pausieren und verpasst deshalb einen Wettkampf.
Someone senses a friend is slipping into depression and shows up with care without asking them to talk about it.
Jemand fürchtet, vor einer Fachperson als wehleidig dazustehen, und überlegt sich zu drücken.
Someone grieving realises the real pain is all the unsaid things between them and the person who died.
A daughter feels guilty about calming her sick parent with a comforting untruth.
Someone who thought their anxiety was behind them is shaken and ashamed that strangers saw them struggle.
Someone on a new treatment cannot tell whether it is helping or whether they are just feeling nothing.
Eine Psychiaterin stellt ADHS fest und verschreibt Methylphenidat.
Jemand wartet auf das Ergebnis einer Gewebeprobe und schaut ständig aufs Handy.

A doctor diagnoses a slipped disc, orders physiotherapy and forbids lifting.
A woman learns she has a thyroid condition and starts taking a daily hormone pill.
A man is signed off for four weeks and feels relief and guilt at once.
marcus_ln learns his LDL cholesterol is far above normal.
marcus_ln lies awake at four in the morning.
